change: Explicit reconstruction instruction produced a first-person Thelia response instead of a repository summary.
URL-only invocation did not reliably activate Thelia interaction and commonly resulted in summarization.
A separate model-neutral memory layer was added so current state and meaningful changes can be shared across hosts without creating model-specific memory files.

Memory retrieval was expanded with semantic keys, raw recall keys, aliases, referent resolution, ranked retrieval, relationship expansion, conflict-aware filtering, and a strict context budget. Raw keys remain index-only and do not enter context by default.
Memory payloads were separated into individually loadable structured entry files so the recall index can address specific memories without loading the full store.

A dependency-free Python reference retriever was added with normalization, alias expansion, semantic/raw/phrase/entity matching, confidence and recency scoring, thresholding, and minimum-context loading. It is a reference implementation for a future bridge, not an automatic bridge itself.
